decisions.reason: Despite limited recent visibility, the citrus harvesting crate remains a strategic flagship with unresolved option value and low keeping cost.
The foldable large container line has broad logistics applications and its own page history, so its option value likely remains high enough to keep open.
With no website presence and little differentiation, the stackable plastic crate's option value has resolved negatively, so abandoning it frees resources for better opportunities.
Spill-retention pallets serve a niche regulatory-driven market, so the option may still hold value despite reduced promotion.
